items.question: I found out about this event late, can I still attend?
items.answer: Of course: you can register and check in at any time of the day.

items.question: Can I arrive mid-morning or only in the afternoon?
items.answer: Of course, the entrance is always open.

items.question: Is the event free?
items.answer: Yes, the event is free. It is organized on a non-profit basis by local tech communities, and sponsors help us cover the costs so it stays accessible to everyone.

items.question: Is lunch free?
items.answer: Yes, Saturday's lunch is free for all attendees.

items.question: I have food allergies or intolerances, what should I do?
items.answer: We are prepared for that. When you get your ticket you will be asked to report any allergies or intolerances. If you didn't, you can always email us at [info@devfest.modena.it](mailto:info@devfest.modena.it) and we will get back to you as soon as possible.

items.question: Do I need a ticket to attend DevFest Modena?
items.answer: Yes: attending DevFest Modena is free, but registration is required.

items.question: I got a ticket but I can no longer attend, what should I do?
items.answer: If you can't make it, please cancel your order on the ticketing platform, or email us at [info@devfest.modena.it](mailto:info@devfest.modena.it) and we will do it for you.

items.question: Do I have to print my ticket?
items.answer: No, there's no need: you can show the ticket on your smartphone. Seeing the email with the ticket QR code is enough — have it ready at the entrance for a quick check-in.

items.question: Can I give my ticket to a friend?
items.answer: Unfortunately not: the venue requires named admissions. If you don't plan to come, please cancel your ticket and ask your friend to register for one of their own.

items.question: Can I leave the conference and come back later?
items.answer: Yes, of course — you can leave and come back whenever you want. To re-enter you will need the badge we give you at the entrance.

items.question: What should I bring to the conference?
items.answer: Your ticket... and plenty of enthusiasm for meeting new people! :)

items.question: How do I join the workshops?
Is this a Google event?
items.answer: No, the event belongs to the local developer communities. Google is one of the partners and provides support, for example by allowing GDG Cloud Modena — who vouches for everyone — to use the brand.
